description: The chief minister also inaugurated healthcare infrastructure worth Rs 139.47 crore focusing on expansion of medical facilities, including patient wards and diagnostic equipment
body_lead: Speaking to reporters, Tamil Nadu Health Minister K. G. Arunraj said the Nalam TN platform operates as a Section 8 non-profit company, enabling members of the public and corporates to make transparent contributions towards strengthening healthcare services in government hospitals across the state (Source: Photo by PTI)
